scope: One fixed pass over ZIP directories and data.pkl metadata of the eight already-complete formal checkpoints, with original proof SHA/latest metadata/current-size provenance; no storage payload read or large checkpoint rehash.
findings: The closed opcode VM represents pickle GLOBAL/REDUCE/NEWOBJ/BUILD as inert metadata nodes except explicitly implemented local container/torch tensor-metadata constructors; no archive callable is imported or executed.

Tensor shape/stride/offset/dtype/storage keys are extracted, selected storage is deduplicated by archive storage key, and storage entry byte sizes are cross-checked against recorded storage elements and dtype.
The reader now asserts payload.config.method equals the requested method and exposes checkpoint path, config method/backbone/model/condition and manifest SHA.

Registered parameters and all buffers are listed; selected byte fields are explicitly before buffer classification. Required OSFT high bases, expert masks and inference state must be separated from derived caches before table use.
CL-MoE method anchors and per-layer task_weights are additionally selected. Unknown model tensor storage is exposed for method-specific classification rather than silently treated as absent.
The existing three EXPORTED before-byte records may be used as independent saved-checkpoint identity/size checks without repeating export, reload or quality scoring.
limitations: This admits metadata extraction only. Per-method inference necessity, registered-buffer classification, required unregistered state and public table values still require result review.
The output is original saved-state, unmerged storage, not a canonical folded representation, full package size, runtime RAM/VRAM, latency, throughput or a compression-performance result.
Additional weight storage must be relative to the same-backbone original pretrained base, not a stage-zero graph already containing adapters.
Unknown serialization structures must stop and preserve the implementation failure; any symbolic repair must be reviewed and must not call torch.load, pickle.load or archive functions.
No guarantee is made from this review that all cloudpickle structures are supported; no checkpoint data.pkl was executed or consumed in this static review.
No reader, model, processor, tensor operation, QA, scoring, bootstrap, GPU or previous export was run.
